title: Case REQ-20261106-LIF002 — travel notice
content:
File note from Grace Williams's annual review with Amelia, Senior Risk Adviser, on Mon 28 Sep 2026 (client number CL-100377).

Travel notice: Grace will be in Italy from 20 Oct to 1 Dec 2026.

Verified contact details at the review: mobile 0491 570 157; email grace.williams@example.com.

Client: Grace Williams, 61 (DOB 22/07/1965), semi-retired school principal who does relief teaching; lives in Hawthorn VIC; widowed in 2018; sons Daniel (32) and James (29). Client of Caldova since 2019.

Cover reviewed: Lyrebird Life policy LB-19004417, held outside super, stepped premiums — life cover $500,000 and trauma cover $200,000. Grace is the policy owner and life insured. Nominated beneficiaries: Daniel 50% and James 50%.

How the note was used on 6 Nov 2026: the portal login from Sydney on 2 Nov and the urgent claim email of 6 Nov didn't fit the travel notice, which supported Felix's HIGH risk rating ('Case REQ-20261106-LIF002 — document checks'). Cara called Grace on her verified mobile 0491 570 157; Grace, in Florence, confirmed she is well and never asked for a claim or a change to her details. The block was approved by Theo and no claim was lodged.
